study type: Case Report (with surgical lung biopsy and autopsy)
cohort: A single full-term newborn who developed severe cardiopulmonary issues shortly after birth.
finding: The case report describes a lethal presentation of Alveolar capillary dysplasia with misalignment of the pulmonary veins (ACD/MPV) in a full-term newborn, confirmed by histopathology and genetic analysis revealing an alteration in the FOXF1 gene, alongside digestive and genital malformations.
